svg.title: The Phantasm parameter map
svg.desc: Parameters are numbered by decade: 1x wave and sequence, 2x oscillators, 3x LFO, mod wheel and pressure, 4x the filter envelope ENV2, 5x the amp envelope ENV1, 6x voice modes, 7x filter and amp, 8x the mod envelope ENV3, 9x actions and instrument settings. The three envelopes share the same second digits: 0 attack, 1 peak, 2 decay, 3 sustain, 4 release.
svg.text: The parameter map: first digit is the section, second the control
PARAM and two digits picks one. The three envelopes share x0-x4: attack, peak, decay, sustain, release.
93 and 94 are actions: they happen when the second digit goes in. 95-98 belong to the instrument, not the patch.
Dashed numbers are unused. The printed card has every range; most parameters also answer the MIDI CC of the same number.
